title: Walk All Four Clues First  (先走完四条线索)

segments.t: 上午的客人们用完早餐后，汉娜、格雷厄姆和凯勒布聚在木制前台旁，端详从薄棉纸下取出的最后一件发现：一只封着红色火漆的小方形信封。请先完整听一遍这一幕。
One tiny square envelope left — and the red wax seal is still completely unbroken!
Look at the compass rose pressed into the wax; that matches your professor, Caleb.
Read the instruction written across the front before anyone touches a paper knife, Hannah.
It says: Honor system! Walk all four clues on Linden Street before opening this letter!
Honor system means no peeking early at the front desk, even for the boss.
How long would it take us to follow all four illustrated cards down Linden Street?
The rooms are tidy, breakfast is cleared, and the morning sun is shining brightly!
Go on, both of you, and take Arthur so he stops pacing around my lobby.
Will you guard the biscuit tin and the front desk while we walk, Graham?
My paper ledger and I are not moving an inch until lunch.
Brass compass in my pocket, four clue cards in hand — where does Card One start?
Right outside our front gate: count twenty paces east along Linden Street!
现在我们逐句回顾第一集这最后一幕的对话。
One tiny square envelope left — and the red wax seal is still completely unbroken!
“还剩最后一只小巧的方形信封——上面的红色火漆印依然完好无损！”放在名词后面的过去分词 left 意为“剩下的、余下的”：
One tiny square envelope left
封着传统的蜡印：
the red wax seal
Look at the compass rose pressed into the wax; that matches your professor, Caleb.
“快看压在火漆上的那枚罗盘玫瑰；这和凯勒布你的教授完全吻合。”过去分词 pressed 搭配介词 into，形象描绘印章在温热蜡封上压出浮雕图案：
pressed into the wax
动词 match 则证实了两者吻合：
that matches your professor
Read the instruction written across the front before anyone touches a paper knife, Hannah.
“汉娜，在任何人动用拆信刀之前，先念念正面写着的提示吧。”信封正面称为 the front：
written across the front
桌面用来裁开火漆封口信件的裁纸刀则是：
a paper knife
It says: Honor system! Walk all four clues on Linden Street before opening this letter!
“上面写着：‘自觉守信！拆开这封信前，先沿着菩提树街走完四条线索！’”表达 honor system 指完全凭借信任与荣誉感自觉遵守的规则：
Honor system!
这里的动词 walk 用作及物动词（“步行走完某段路线”）：
Walk all four clues
Honor system means no peeking early at the front desk, even for the boss.
“‘自觉守信’的意思就是，哪怕是老板，也不许在前台提前偷看。”结构 no + -ing 动名词用来礼貌而幽默地表达“禁止做某事”：
no peeking early
How long would it take us to follow all four illustrated cards down Linden Street?
“顺着菩提树街走完这四张彩绘卡片大概需要多久？”推算假设中的某项活动要花多长时间，常用句型 How long would it take + 人 + 带 to 不定式：
How long would it take us
走完这一趟线索之旅：
to follow all four illustrated cards
The rooms are tidy, breakfast is cleared, and the morning sun is shining brightly!
“客房都收拾妥当了，早餐也清理干净了，清晨的阳光正明媚地照耀着呢！”汉娜兴致勃勃地细数早晨的活计全都做完了：
The rooms are tidy
并用这句话欣喜地称赞好天气：
the morning sun is shining brightly
Go on, both of you, and take Arthur so he stops pacing around my lobby.
“你们俩去吧，把亚瑟也带走，省得他在我大堂里踱来踱去。”短语动词 Go on 温和地催促大家快动身：
Go on, both of you
而动词 pace 活灵活现地画出亚瑟坐立不安、来回踱步的样子：
so he stops pacing around my lobby
Will you guard the biscuit tin and the front desk while we walk, Graham?
“格雷厄姆，我们去走的时候，你能替我们看守好饼干铁盒和前台吗？”动词 guard（“守护、看守珍宝”）给这句提问增添了一丝庄重的俏皮感：
Will you guard the biscuit tin
My paper ledger and I are not moving an inch until lunch.
“在午饭前，我和我的纸质登记簿绝对寸步不移。”出于英语礼貌习惯，并列主语中的人称代词 I 总要放在第二位：
My paper ledger and I
习语 not move an inch（“一英寸也不挪动”）相当于中文的“寸步不移”：
are not moving an inch
Brass compass in my pocket, four clue cards in hand — where does Card One start?
“黄铜指南针揣在兜里，四张线索卡拿在手里——第一张卡从哪儿开始？”不加冠词的短语 in hand 意为“拿在手中，准备妥当”：
four clue cards in hand
Right outside our front gate: count twenty paces east along Linden Street!
“就在咱们大门正外面：沿着菩提树街向东数二十步！”用 right outside 精准点出出发的起点：
Right outside our front gate
而在指路说明中，用来丈量距离的步伐就叫 paces：
count twenty paces east
让我们从头到尾再完整听一遍整段对话。
One tiny square envelope left — and the red wax seal is still completely unbroken!
Look at the compass rose pressed into the wax; that matches your professor, Caleb.
Read the instruction written across the front before anyone touches a paper knife, Hannah.
It says: Honor system! Walk all four clues on Linden Street before opening this letter!
Honor system means no peeking early at the front desk, even for the boss.
How long would it take us to follow all four illustrated cards down Linden Street?
The rooms are tidy, breakfast is cleared, and the morning sun is shining brightly!
Go on, both of you, and take Arthur so he stops pacing around my lobby.
Will you guard the biscuit tin and the front desk while we walk, Graham?
My paper ledger and I are not moving an inch until lunch.
Brass compass in my pocket, four clue cards in hand — where does Card One start?
Right outside our front gate: count twenty paces east along Linden Street!
信守三十年前的诚信约定，小伙伴们把黄铜指南针揣进口袋，迈步走上菩提树街去解开全部四条线索！第一集完——我们第二集见！
See you soon!
